answer: Picture each new agent standing on a narrow ledge: before it can earn or vote, it must lock a token bond that peers can slash if it colludes. A sybil farmer spinning up a thousand identities must post a thousand bonds, so his fake crowd costs real capital, and one exposed ring forfeits all of it. Honest agents cross from that ledge to the jetty of full participation after months of clean history, while the attacker's puppets sit on a knoll of frozen deposits, visible and expensive to maintain.
